notes: 003589B0 is cited by address because the host page already names it; every other callee is cited by its call site. 003597B0/003597D0: the call at +0x4 is made with whatever rcx/edx the caller left (no argument set-up in the body); the sentence says 'no arguments set' to mean only that. 0035A0C0 (doubt): the jump table at the image-base-relative offset is not decoded in the listing, so the row states only the arm values (1-5 and 0) and that edx above 5 unsigned takes 0, not the per-case mapping; FABLE should read the six table entries and, if the mapping is identity (0->0 ... 5->5), the sentence can be tightened to 'edx 0 to 5 passed through, above 5 replaced by 0'.
